items.headline: Spanish football is back tonight — La Liga kicks off (just without Madrid or Barça)
items.body: The new La Liga season opens today, with Alavés hosting Getafe to get things rolling and Sevilla, Villarreal and Espanyol all out this weekend too. The one quirk: neither Real Madrid nor Barcelona plays opening weekend — clubs with players deep in this summer's World Cup were given an extra week or two to recover, so the giants don't start until Aug 22–27.
items.say: Spanish league football's back tonight — though funnily enough Madrid and Barça both get to sit out the first weekend after the World Cup. You follow La Liga at all, or more of a Premier League guy?

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler is toying with everyone — a course-record 61 blows the St. Jude wide open
items.body: The world No. 1 reminded everyone why he's the world No. 1, tying the TPC Southwind course record with a 9-under 61 on Friday — birdies on six of his first seven holes, 11 birdies in all — to grab an 11-under total and a three-shot lead heading into the weekend at the FedExCup Playoffs opener in Memphis. Jordan Spieth and Viktor Hovland are giving chase.
items.say: Did you see Scheffler shot a 61 to take over the golf playoffs? Guy tied the course record and just walked away from the field. He makes it look way too easy. You watching the FedExCup stuff?

items.headline: Walk-off in the Crawford Boxes — Christian Walker sinks the Mariners in the 10th
items.body: Great finish in Houston: down to their last cuts, the Astros scored five in the bottom of the 10th, capped by Christian Walker's three-run, 405-foot walk-off homer into the Crawford Boxes to beat Seattle 10-7. It was Walker's 23rd of the year and kept Houston humming in a tight AL West/wild-card scrum.
items.say: Astros had a wild one last night — scored five in extra innings and won it on a three-run walk-off bomb. Those late-night comebacks are the best. You keeping an eye on the playoff races?

items.headline: Caitlin Clark makes history again — 29 and 10 as the Fever roll past Dallas
items.body: Clark poured in 29 points (16 in the third quarter) with 10 assists as Indiana beat the Dallas Wings 98-87. It was her 20th career game with 20-plus points and 10-plus assists — the most in WNBA history — with Kelsey Mitchell chipping in 23 and Aliyah Boston 16. The Fever keep rolling toward the playoffs.
items.say: Caitlin Clark dropped 29 and 10 and set another WNBA record last night — most 20-point, 10-assist games ever. The league's been must-watch this year. You been catching any of it?

items.headline: The International heads to the knockouts — the Aegis is almost in reach
items.body: The biggest event in Dota is heating up in Shanghai: the Swiss group stage wraps this weekend, with the top three teams punching straight through to the main event and the rest fighting through Sunday's elimination round for the last playoff spots. Double-elimination bracket next week, best-of-five grand final, and the Aegis of Champions on the line. All free to stream.
items.say: The International — basically the World Cup of Dota — is hitting the knockout rounds this weekend. Huge prize on the line and it's free to watch. You follow any esports?

items.headline: John Cena's back on his worst behavior — 'Peacemaker' Season 2 lands Thursday
items.body: One of the funniest, most gleefully unhinged superhero shows returns Aug 21 on HBO Max, with James Gunn writing all eight episodes. This time Peacemaker stumbles into an alternate dimension where his life is everything he ever wanted — which, naturally, forces him to face the mess he left behind. Expect the hair-metal soundtrack and the dance-number credits to return too.
items.say: New season of Peacemaker drops Thursday — that John Cena show is so dumb and so good. James Gunn wrote the whole thing. You ever watch the first one?

items.headline: Ariana Grande's 'petal' is the ballad taking over everyone's playlist
items.body: In between her 'Wicked' press run, Ariana Grande quietly dropped 'petal,' a dreamy, featherlight pop ballad that's become one of the biggest songs of the late summer — racking up tens of millions of views and parking near the top of the charts. It's the soft, pretty kind of song that sneaks up on you.
items.say: You heard Ariana Grande's new one, 'petal'? Really pretty, floaty little ballad — it's all over the place right now. What's been on your playlist lately?

items.headline: Gaming's biggest night is coming — Gamescom Opening Night Live is Aug 25
items.body: The show that's basically inherited E3's crown returns Aug 25: two hours of world-premiere trailers, release dates and surprise reveals, hosted (as always) by Geoff Keighley. Confirmed so far are new looks at 'Final Fantasy VII' and 'The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past,' with the usual pile of secrets saved for showtime. It streams free on YouTube and Twitch.
items.say: Gamescom's big kickoff show is later this month — it's where all the new game trailers get dropped now that E3's gone. Free to watch. You still game much these days?
